status: Stage 0 complete; local implementation gate positive; official final-subprocess FlopScope and protected-score gate pending

candidate_final_layer_chunk2048.algorithm: Keep the first 31 layers unchanged. For the last weight only, call the existing partial-tree Winograd kernel on 2,048-row slices, ReLU each slice, cast to float64, sum immediately, and divide once.
candidate_final_layer_chunk2048.final_output_identity: mu_hat = N^{-1} sum_c sum_{i in c} ReLU(H_i W_32)
candidate_final_layer_chunk2048.predicted_raw_candidate_base: approximately 1.0; exact estimator and point set, reduction order only
candidate_final_layer_chunk2048.promotion_gate: Run paired official subprocess baseline/candidate. Promote only if measured effective compute falls, raw MSE is unchanged within numerical drift, and no tail regression occurs.

candidate_final_layer_chunk512.role: lowest-memory fallback if 2,048 rows fails the subprocess residual-time gate

penultimate_translation_reuse.identity: If Z=HW and H_corrected=H+1 delta^T, then H_corrected W = Z + 1 (delta^T W). Cache Z and avoid the second final-layer replay.
penultimate_translation_reuse.scope_note: Useful only for correction formulations that otherwise require both baseline and uniformly translated final replay. The currently preferred direct final-output control may not need it.

feature_reuse.conclusion: Compute K32/K128 summaries from existing activations; never pay for separate propagation.

closed_or_not_promoted.persistent_64_block: Archived variant lowers tracked FLOPs but raises residual wall enough to worsen effective compute; do not revive unchanged.
closed_or_not_promoted.chunk_every_layer: Not attempted/promoted because it changes reduction order at every layer and can compound gate drift. The frozen candidate chunks only the last layer.
closed_or_not_promoted.mixed_precision: Not promoted; current float32 Winograd plus float64 final reduction is retained.
